bullets.title: Huy Fong’s Sriracha hit revenue of $150m+ a year...with no sales team, no trademark and $0 in ad spend. Its creator is Vietnamese-American David Tran, making the sauce’s success a tale of immigrant hustle and a product that literally sells itself. Here’s the story🧵…
bullets.note: (hat tip to Mike N.).** Tired of all the smoke and mirrors of overhyped entrepreneurship? All the hand-wavy buzz words of the startup _du jour_? This is a wonderful story of product, product, product meets focus, focus, focus.

bullets.title: Roman Gonzalez vs Brian Viloria - Highlights (Explosive FIGHT & KNOCKOUT)
bullets.note: ](https://youtu.be/pJyb5ya5MOI)**” (via Ralphbert).** This highlight video is absurd. Be sure to watch at least three minutes. It boggles my mind that anyone can throw nonstop power punches for so long with such precision. But who are we dealing with here? This machine in the blue shorts: “Román Alberto González Luna \[[@chocolatitobox](https://twitter.com/chocolatitobox)\] (born 16 June 1987), best known by his nickname ‘Chocolatito,’ is a Nicaraguan professional boxer. He is the first boxer from Nicaragua to win world titles in four weight classes, having surpassed his mentor, idol, and former three-weight world champion, the late Alexis Argüello. González is also the first boxer in history to win world titles in all four of the lowest weight classes: minimumweight, light flyweight, flyweight, and super flyweight. … From September 2015 to March 2017, he was also ranked by _The Ring_ as the world’s best active boxer, pound for pound.” ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rom%C3%A1n_Gonz%C3%A1lez_(boxer)))

bullets.title: Screenplayed: Comparing Movies to Screenplays
bullets.note: ([@screenplayed](https://twitter.com/screenplayed)). This is the art of explaining art. Screenplayed uses a split screen to help you watch scenes of movies while simultaneously reading along in the final script. To get a quick taste, [check out this example from _Uncut Gems_](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uzZnBXHHTro). Many thanks to Jordan B. for introducing me to this.
